description: When now_unix < this_update the code returns Err(OcspStatusUnknown). A future-dated thisUpdate is a malformed/clock-skew condition, not an authoritative 'unknown' status. Should return Err(Error::OcspMalformed) to match how producedAt is handled. File: pkix-revocation/src/ocsp.rs lines 181, 287.
title: ocsp: thisUpdate future-date returns wrong error
